Send an enquiry and we will contact you
Spire King’s Lynn Clinic offers convenient access to private consultations with expert specialists - right in the heart of King’s Lynn.

Whether you want to discuss symptoms, seek a second opinion, or explore treatment options, our specialists are here to listen, guide you, and support you in making informed decisions about your health.
If you need further tests or treatment, we can arrange these for you quickly at one of our nearby Spire hospitals, so you can continue your care without delay.
With appointment times designed to fit your schedule and a welcoming, professional team, we’re here to make your healthcare journey as smooth as possible.
Spire King’s Lynn Clinic provides an outpatient service by a team of dedicated consultants specialising in:

end of heading, Travel instructions, level 2
Depart the A148 at Knights Hill roundabout, taking the exit onto Grimston Road. Continue onto Low Road/A1078 for half a mile before turning right into Spire King's Lynn Clinic.
Drive along the A148/London road leading onto John Kennedy Road/A148. Continue along Edward Benefer Way for 0.2 miles. Spire King's Lynn Clinic will be on your left-hand side.
Spire King's Lynn Clinic is approximately 2.5 miles from King's Lynn train station.
